exposure: suspension of intrapartum maternal oxygen supplementation
Suspension of intrapartum maternal oxygen supplementation for nonreassuring fetal heart rate
outcome: Composite neonatal outcome (arterial cord pH <7.1, mechanical ventilation, respiratory distress syndrome, necrotizing enterocolitis, intraventricular hemorrhage grade 3/4, neonatal death)
cohort: Individuals with singleton pregnancies who underwent labor at a single tertiary medical center
finding: Suspension of intrapartum oxygen treatment for nonreassuring fetal heart rate was associated with a higher rate of composite adverse neonatal outcomes and increased cesarean sections due to fetal heart rate concerns.
mod_finding: Suspension of intrapartum oxygen treatment for nonreassuring fetal heart rate was associated with a higher rate of cesarean sections due to fetal heart rate concerns.
